chunks: Those who denied the Book and what We sent down with Our apostles, will soon come to know.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people that will soon come to know the truth of their denial?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ghafir highlights the inevitable reckoning for those who dismissed both the Quran and the Prophets, emphasizing that divine justice is not delayed but merely awaited. It serves as a comfort to the faithful, particularly the Ahl al-Bayt and their followers, assuring them that the truth of their Imams' authority will become manifest to the deniers in the Hereafter.
